newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber up limit on short covering, firm cash.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber up limit on short covering, firm cash.

text.p: July and September CME lumber futures ran up the $10.00 per thousand board foot daily limit and other months were up sharply as short covering and support from stronger cash indications triggered buy stops, traders said.
July was up limit at $382.00 and September was limit up at $364.80 per tbf. Other months were up $6.90 to $4.50 per tbf.

Early selling pressure lacked follow through and prices jumped on talk of further strength in cash lumber. Random Lengths quoted cash spruce up $8 from last Friday and there were reports that some lumber may be trading $5 higher than the quoted levels, traders said.
